description:
A useful subsidy offer can be easy to lose in a busy game. Subsidy Manager keeps your offers, accepted tasks and past outcomes together in one window, so you can spend more time planning your routes.

FEATURES
• Offered: compare destinations, requirements, rewards and time left.
• In Progress: follow accepted tasks, progress and deadlines.
• History: look back at successful and failed subsidies.
• Click any row to open the game's full subsidy details and map highlights.

HOW TO USE
1. Click the contract icon beside Industry Statistics in the bottom-right toolbar.
2. Choose Offered, In Progress or History.
3. Click a subsidy to open its details, then Accept or Decline as usual.
4. Press Refresh to update the window while it is open.

A small dot on the toolbar icon means new offers have arrived since you last opened the manager. The window can be moved and pinned.

HIDE OFFERS (OPTIONAL)
Want fewer interruptions? Tick Hide offers beside Refresh.
• Off by default. Your choice is saved with your game.
• New offers are saved quietly instead of appearing.
• Current offers and accepted tasks are not affected.
• Offers keep arriving at the game's normal pace.

When you untick Hide offers:
• Saved offers that are still valid appear in Offered.
• A yellow dot on Offered and on the toolbar icon marks them. Hover over Offered to see how many.
• Click one to Accept or Decline it as normal.
• Saved offers keep their original terms. Their time left pauses while hidden.
• Offers that are no longer valid move to History as Expired, with no penalty.
• Show declined also lists offers you declined yourself.

Up to 50 hidden offers, 20 declined offers and 20 Expired entries are kept. When a limit is reached, the oldest is removed.

GOOD TO KNOW
• The window updates when you open it, press Refresh or untick Hide offers.
• The game decides how long History keeps successful and failed subsidies.
• A dash (—) means the game didn't provide that value. Hover for details.
• Worker progress shows the game's workforce-boost percentage, not a passenger count.
• Recovery covers the four standard subsidy types and offers saved since v1.3.0.
• Campaign mission subsidies are never hidden.
• No keyboard shortcut is added. English is the only language for now.

CHANGES

v1.4.0 — Crash fix and lighter saves
• Fixed a crash that could occur while starting or loading a game.
• Hide offers no longer makes new offers arrive faster than normal.
• Saved offers are now limited (50 hidden, 20 declined, 20 Expired), keeping long games light.

v1.3.1 — More reliable toolbar
• Renamed Auto-decline to Hide offers, with clearer guidance.
• Unticking Hide offers refreshes the window once the game confirms it.
• Offers you have already seen are not announced again.
• More reliable toolbar start-up. Hiding keeps working without the toolbar icon.
• Updated gallery images.

v1.3.0 — Recover hidden subsidies
• Hidden offers are saved, so you can review and accept them later.
• Yellow dots on the toolbar icon and Offered show when missed offers are available.
• Saved offers keep their terms, and their time left pauses while saved.
• Offers that are no longer valid move to History as Expired, with no penalty.
• Show declined lists offers you declined yourself.

v1.2.0 — Auto-decline new offers
• Added an optional Auto-decline toggle beside Refresh, off by default.
• Your choice is saved per game. Existing offers and accepted tasks are kept.

v1.1.2 — Clearer overview
• History shows each outcome once, in Status.
• Missing values show a dash with an explanation.
• More reliable progress and reward details. Zero worker progress shows as 0% Workers.

v1.1.1 — Clearer guidance
• Clearer instructions for each section and for Refresh.

v1.1.0 — Easier-to-read tables
• Rewards and effects appear on separate lines, and long text wraps.
• Illustrated empty views, with a compact window when every section is empty.
• New cover and gallery.

v1.0.1 — Description update
• Improved the Mod Hub summary and description.

v1.0.0 — Initial release
• Offered, In Progress and History views with counts, opened from the toolbar.
• Open the game's subsidy details and map highlights from any row.

summary: Compare subsidy offers, follow your progress and find your next opportunity in one place.
